I couldn't put it on talk-one.mp4 for you. None of my Magic Hour tools can place an image on top of a video. The only tool that changes an existing video is the AI video editor, and it re-creates every frame from a prompt. Your footage would change, the fox might not look exactly the same, and it wouldn't stay in a fixed spot.

To add it without changing anything else, use any video editor (CapCut, iMovie, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or Canva):
- Import talk-one.mp4, then add the PNG as an image or overlay layer on top.
- Stretch the image layer to cover the whole video.
- Scale it to about 10–15% of the video's width.
- Place it in the top-right corner, with a gap of about 3–5% of the width from the top and right edges.
- Export. The video and sound stay as they were.

If you still want me to try the AI video editor, tell me. Just expect the footage to change.
